approval.note: Trump job approval, net (approve minus disapprove): average of the RealClearPolling (-20.0) and Silver Bulletin (-20.4) nets as of Nov 2-3, 2026 (-20.2, rounded to the nearest 0.5: -20.0), up from -22.5 on Nov 2. RealClearPolling's page as opened on Nov 3 shows 39.1/59.1 for polls 10/14-11/1 (its page had shown a stale 10/9-10/25 average, 38.2/60.3, on Nov 2). Silver Bulletin's page (updated Nov 2) prints approve 38.4% and disapprove 'about 59 percent'; The Hill's Nov 2 report of the same average gives 38.4/58.8, which is used for its net. The New York Times average (37/60, net -23) as reported by The Hill is a check; FiftyPlusOne's page could not be opened on Nov 3.
sources: Silver Bulletin average, updated Nov 2: approve 38.4%, disapprove 'about 59 percent' (58.8 per The Hill; net -20.4)
The Hill (via Yahoo), Nov 2: RCP 39.3/58.8, Silver Bulletin 38.4/58.8, New York Times 37/60

specials.note: Average Democratic improvement on the 2024 presidential margin across D-vs-R special elections since January 2025. The Downballot's Oct 20, 2026 update ('Special elections show Democrats headed for a year as good as 2018, if not better') remains paywalled with no tally visible (last checked Nov 3), so the Aug 19 tally stays; MultiState's 2026-only median (+10.4 across 37 contested specials through April) is a different measure and is not used

offyear.note: 2025 governor margin minus the state's 2024 presidential margin
